thread:
mike.k: Heads up — multiple customer reports of 502s hitting hosted inference endpoints starting ~12:00 PDT. Small sync POSTs (/v1/generate). Affected tenants: acme, beta-co, free-tier. Escalations from support.
anya.p: Any deploys or infra changes?
mike.k: No deploys. We rotated a billing/auth token around 11:58 which overlaps. Repro steps: curl POST -> 502 intermittently.
juan.c: I'm pulling traces now. Seeing a pattern: upstream midfront returning FIN/RST during TLS handshake for some flows.
sre-bot: [alert] edge-gw-502-spike: 150 events in last 10m, peak 7% error rate. top-upstream: midfront-eu3
ops-jen: Checked LB health — all targets healthy. No config reloads logged.
anya.p: Could be connection pool exhaustion on midfront after rotation. Any TIME_WAIT / port exhaustion?
juan.c: Snapshot of netstat shows high TIME_WAIT and many ephemeral ports in use on midfront. A few sockets in CLOSE_WAIT.
mike.k: Support shared a cURL sample. Small payload, no streaming. Happens when token header changes mid-session.
juan.c: Reproduced locally by alternating auth header between requests rapidly. midfront drops connection during TLS handshake -> envoy returns 502.
anya.p: Quick mitigation: scale midfront by +2, and increase keepalive to 90s. Also reduce envoy immediate retry fanout (backoff 50ms->200ms) to avoid amplifying connection churn.
ops-jen: Scaling now, patching keepalive. Also toggled connection_reuse: true -> false for the pool to force fresh connects for a short window (trial).
mike.k: Pushed changes. Rolling monitor.
anya.p: Added temporary rate cap on free-tier to limit blast radius.
juan.c: After scale and keepalive bump, 502 rate dropped to ~0.7% in 6m (was ~6%). Client repro attempts confirm improvement.
mike.k: Verified with customer — errors reduced, streaming OK. Will follow up with postmortem.
ops-jen: Logged ticket ENG-2143 to investigate root cause: probable auth-rotation + midfront connpool leak + short keepalive leading to handshake races. Add metrics: conn_open, conn_close, TIME_WAIT, tls_handshake_fail by tenant.
anya.p: I'll draft customer comms and coordinate rollback plan if it reappears.
juan.c: Next steps: run longer soak with auth-rotation at scale, add graceful drain on token rotate, and add alert on midfront TIME_WAIT surge.
mike.k: Thanks — assigning owners in ENG-2143. Will update when postmortem draft ready. :thumbsup:
